title: Source
description: An information source and its compliance decision. The record carries both the candidate-source fields of spec 8.5 (what discovery produces) and the compliance-record fields of spec 6.7 (what the compliance gate produces), because the gate's output is consumed directly as a source record. A source is only ever collected from after the gate recorded ALLOWED.

source_id.description: Stable id for the source, shared across research projects.

source_name.description: Display name of the source, for example the host of the base URL.

base_url.description: Canonical base URL of the source.

source_type.description: Kind of source, for example official_site, media, paper, report, community.

industry_tags.description: Industry tags used for classified archiving and local retrieval.

topic_tags.description: Topic tags used for classified archiving and local retrieval.

authority_level.description: Assessed authority of the source, for example primary, established, secondary, unknown.

discovery_method.description: How the source was found, for example manual or llm. Sources proposed by the model stay unverified until a real request confirms them.

discovery_verified.description: True only when the source existence and base URL were confirmed by a real request during discovery.

robots_url.description: URL of the robots.txt consulted for this source.

terms_url.description: URL of the terms or licence page. When present, v1 parks the source at REVIEW_REQUIRED.

compliance_status.description: Outcome of the compliance gate. BLOCKED means policy forbids collection; ERROR means the check failed; UNREACHABLE means robots.txt could not be read, which pauses the source rather than allowing it.

allowed_paths.description: Path prefixes the gate permits collecting from. The collector must not go outside them.

access_method.description: How the source is read, for example web, rss or api.

feed_url.description: Transport address an rss source is read at. REQUIRED when access_method is rss: an rss source with no non-empty feed_url is refused by the collector, there is no fallback to base_url. The field stays optional in this schema only because web and api sources do not carry it. It must name the same host as base_url: the collector refuses a different host, and the compliance gate evaluates this address's path before collection.

api_url.description: Transport address an api source is read at. REQUIRED when access_method is api: an api source with no non-empty api_url is refused by the collector, there is no fallback to base_url. The field stays optional in this schema only because web and rss sources do not carry it. It must name the same host as base_url: the collector refuses a different host, and the compliance gate evaluates this address's path before collection.

last_checked_at.description: Timestamp of the last compliance check, ISO 8601.

selection_status.description: Whether the planner chose this source for the current round.

domain.description: Domain the source belongs to; the unit the request rate limit is applied to.

checked_at.description: Timestamp when the compliance record was assembled, ISO 8601.

robots_status.description: Robots outcome, for example ok, absent, blocked or error.

terms_status.description: Terms outcome, for example absent, present or unknown.

request_rate_limit.description: Minimum seconds between requests to this domain.

evidence.description: What the compliance decision was based on, so it can be audited later.

type.description: Kind of evidence, for example robots_txt or terms_page.

url.description: URL the evidence was read from.

detail.description: What was found, for example the matching Disallow rule.

note.description: Short human-readable note on how the evidence drove the decision.

notes.description: Free-form research or compliance notes about this source.
